title: Fieldset
summary: A named set of fields (role=group with a legend) that can be disabled together.

examples.label: A legend over related fields
examples.subject: component:fieldset
examples.markup: <ui-fieldset legend="Billing address"><ui-input name="street" label="Street"></ui-input><ui-input name="city" label="City"></ui-input><ui-field label="Plan"><ui-radio-group name="plan" value="pro" orientation="horizontal"><ui-radio value="free">Free</ui-radio><ui-radio value="pro">Pro</ui-radio></ui-radio-group></ui-field></ui-fieldset>

examples.label: Disabled together
examples.subject: component:fieldset
examples.markup: <ui-fieldset legend="Shipping" disabled><ui-input label="Street" value="Storgatan 1"></ui-input><ui-checkbox checked>Same as billing</ui-checkbox></ui-fieldset>
